minimum_requirements_before_one_fork_lau: Prepare and freeze a separate fork-only packet and launcher rooted at this exact checkout and HEAD. V3 intentionally contains no fork launcher.
Bind this review and the preserved v3 receipt, exact original argv, entry snapshot, five retained artifact hashes, and byte-exact produced T17. Reuse the fidelity pass and do not repeat T16-to-T17.

Use a fresh immutable T16 restart for the candidate fork, a fixed absent attempt leaf, a 180000 ms hard cap, an expected duration below 120000 ms, at most 23 normal advances, one attempt, and no automatic retry, alternate input, native run, package build, or 188-turn campaign.

Use the current-source public REQUEST_OPERATION query on a dedicated clone. Require an accepted, finite-physics result; prove query purity against the complete clone; and fail closed on rejection, missing physics, invalid ownership, missing force, or any requestless path.

Stage exactly once through the real production staging path with 4th Corps ownership, Tosici target, Delijas staging, cost 25, and command-authority transition RBiH 94/0/25 to 69/25/50. Preserve president request versus corps-command force/axis/launch ownership.

Derive the force only from the actual query result and production selector. Require 3 through 12 canonical same-corps, active, statewide-uncommitted, non-enclave, reachable brigades from the frozen T16 pool; do not inject, override, replace, or tune the roster.

Disclose the concurrent 1st Corps Operation Circle target at Tosici. The production overlap guard is same-corps, so this cross-corps overlap is an ordinary permitted input condition; no scenario exemption may be added.

Consume the staged request through the production turn advance and preserve operation-owned movement, combat, and control lineage. Replay only retained player-event inputs through the production consumer at their actual T20, T38, and T39 timing; fail closed on any blocker.

Preserve the actual Package03 704 comparator, reference, n91, n92, and the three retained loss IDs. At T39 require at least 707 of 712 and zero formerly-correct losses; report a partial delivery distinctly and make no full-parity or baseline-adoption claim.

Freeze the exact fork source, runtime, inputs, selectors, wrapper, allowlist, and provenance before launch. Retain complete stdout, stderr, receipt, reports, state files, query/stage/force/CA/lineage/event evidence, score/loss evidence, hashes, exits, and preservation checks.
Obtain a targeted independent prelaunch GO on the actual frozen fork-only files and an explicit owner launch decision. This fidelity review alone does not authorize the fork.
